TEXT:
At the place where Kirino brought me to... that 
person was already waiting for us.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I got a call from Kirino-chan... telling me to come 
here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hmm? Do you have a complaint about that? Calling 
her "Mana-chan" like I used to would sound childish.
That wasn't what I was surprised about...

Kirino always acts strangely disgusted towards 
Manami whenever she acts over-familiar towards 
her.

Back then, when I brought Manami over to our 
place...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's been a while. Do you remember me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I don't remember you at all. Who might you be?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Kirino, why are you acting like this today... Wait, did 
you remember about the past?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
"Mana-chan", huh... Even I forgot that you called her 
that.

And this location... she called it "where we used to 
play together as kids".
Isn't that being vague on purpose?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Thank you for remembering me, Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Even though you came all the way to our house to 
hang out, I only said unpleasant things to you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
It's fine. I understand Kirino-chan's feelings 
somewhat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Thank you for forgiving me, Manami-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Kirino-chan is an important childhood friend... like a 
little sister to me, after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If possible... I thought it would be nice if we could 
get along like we did in the past~

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Even now... I wonder if that's okay?
Now then, how will Kirino react to this...

Depending on the situation, I might need to step in 
and mediate.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: We might... be able to get along.
Then, Kirino looked up at me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: I was able... to reconcile with even Kyousuke, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Anything else is easier than that.
That's right. The two of us really... didn't get along.
Surely, even Manami and Kirino can...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Then.. although it's weird to say "let's make up"...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Shall we... get along with each other again, 
Kirino-chan?
Manami timidly held out her right hand.
Then Kirino, as if she had planned for that...

Acting as if she couldn't resist laughing, yet 
sporadically bursting into laughter.
And after being so ecstatic , Kirino began to speak.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
The truth is, Kyousuke and I~, aren't related by 
blood~♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
It's really true♪ If you think I'm lying, ask 
Kyousuke about it.

From the beginning, the reason Kirino had called 
out Manami was to explain the circumstances 
surrounding that to her.
...This girl really does things her own way.

Even though it's something that has greatly 
influenced my life.

Back when Rock (Manami's younger brother) got 
100% on a test by a fluke, her reaction was the 
exact same.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
So! And then! There's still more!! This next part is 
the most important!

Kirino says that to Manami... as if she had returned 
to being an innocent child.
Kirino suddenly locked arms with me tightly.

Is there a point in uselessly stirring up the sense of 
surprise like this?
Manami was still in a daze.

On the other hand, Kirino looked at her shocked 
face, and...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
It's Kiririn's overwhelming victory! Kuhihihihi, I've 
al~ways wanted to see that expression!!

Kirino thrusted her finger towards Manami's face 
and started ridiculing her with all her strength.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Hey, how do you feel right now? Hey, hey, 
Manami-san, how does it feel now that Kyousuke 
has been taken by me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Alright then, now that you've savored that feeling! 
Let's shake hands and make up!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Give it a rest, you fool.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Geez... Doing that kind of bullying in bad taste right 
in front of me is just like you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Of course I'm going to hit anyone that makes fun 
of Manami, even my own girlfriend.

Kirino tried to say something with a rebellious look 
in her eye, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hurry up and apologize, come on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: B-But... my grudge from all those years ago...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see. Then... I've had enough. You...

Kirino lowered her head, took a quick glance at 
Manami's face.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I see... So Kirino-chan wanted to say that to me for 
all this time.

She doesn't look like she's reflecting on her actions 
at all.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Ahaha, I see. You got back at me real good.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: It's something between the two of us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Yes, something between us. It has nothing to do 
with you.
Basically telling me to step aside for this.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
I don't think what I said back then was wrong... That 
hasn't changed, even now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Oh really? But, since it's like this now, you can't 
object, right?
I didn't understand the conversation at all.
I know it's about something important.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
After all, siblings dating each other... I don't think 
that's normal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Look! I told you we aren't related by blood!

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Even if you're aren't related by blood, I think 
siblings should just be siblings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you... opposed to Kirino and I dating?
Since I've known her for a long time, I understand.
Manami is opposed to us going out. For real.

And, changing her opinion when she becomes like 
this is almost next to impossible.

I've always thought that no matter who became 
my enemy, this person at least... would always side 
with me.

To think... that I would make Manami my enemy 
today.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I want to support Kyou-chan if he has a lover, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Only if it's Kirino-chan, then it becomes a different 
situation.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I mean, you two are siblings, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
In that case... if I think that siblings dating each 
other is strange, that means it's the "normal" way 
of thinking, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
"But, that has nothing to do with this~", are you 
going to yell that now? Like you did in the past.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Like when you stood up to your father.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
Do you think you can also coax me just with your 
enthusiasm and passion?

Up until now, I resolved many troubles... by leaving it 
to just that.

I settled the problems of my little sister and the 
others with a suicide charge as I resolved myself 
to death.

But... Manami is the only person that tactic won't 
work on.

No matter what vivid words I yell at her, I cannot 
convince Manami here.
I can't persuade her with a sob story either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Even if it's impossible, I have to do it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
More important than my parents or anyone else, if 
you don't approve of it... then it's no good to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yeah. I thought you would say that, knowing you.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
If I don't approve it, you can no longer date 
Kirino-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hmm? But, that's how it is, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
"You should ignore what the plain girl says and just 
enjoy yourself with me."

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
...That kind of thing won't get through to this guy, 
after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
Unless we get your blessing the right way, I can't 
feel satisfied.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: Oh yeah? Whatever you say then.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: It's not like it'll change what we have to do, anyway.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
This time, right now... I'm not leaving it all up to you 
alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT:
I'll charge into this together with you, break 
through this with you.
